name: Lab: 24-2 (42 points), eye tracker, 51 cm
description: The study setup. BenQ 24.5" (544 x 303 mm), chin rest at 51 cm (the Tobii Pro Fusion works from 50 cm; the grid fits up to 52.8 cm). 24-2 positions without the top/bottom rows and the 2 nasal 27-deg points: 42 points, 6 deg apart. Full Threshold 4-2 staircase (OPI). Start python\specvis.bat tracker-bridge first. The app checks the eye distance, calibrates the tracker, measures its accuracy, and gives fixation feedback. Choose the ColorCAL scale "Lab screen".
